name: t01v2_marked_live_02
command:
import pathlib,json
from src.tools.t01v2_live_progress import ROOT,read_prefix,observed_counts,archive
root=ROOT/'logs/runs/t01v2_marked_live_02/snapshots';root.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=False)
for name in ["pilot_pairs_v2_marked_kitchen_1_2_01_j707403_hopper_m_02_g0_floorplan1","pilot_pairs_v2_marked_kitchen_1_2_01_j707403_hopper_m_02_g0_floorplan2","pilot_pairs_v2_marked_living_201_202_01_j707475_hopper_m_02_g0_floorplan201","pilot_pairs_v2_marked_living_201_202_01_j707475_hopper_m_02_g0_floorplan202"]:
 p=ROOT/'data/world_pairs/v2'/(name+'_attempts.jsonl')
 if not p.exists():
  print(json.dumps({'name':name,'status':'not_yet_observed'}));continue
 raw,info=read_prefix(p)
 ref=archive(raw,root,name+'.jsonl')
 print(json.dumps({'name':name,'scope':'producer_reported_live_not_independent_acceptance','source':ref,**observed_counts(raw,'FloorPlan'+name.split('floorplan')[-1])},sort_keys=True))
